item.summary: The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) has fully subscribed ₹4 crore to the maiden Zero Coupon Zero Principal (ZCZP) issue of the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) on the Social Stock Exchange (SSE) platform of the National Stock Exchange (NSE), marking an important milestone in the evolution of outcome-based social finance in India. item.title: NABARD subscribes ₹4 Crore to NSDCs Social Stock Exchange Issue to support overseas employment of rural youth
